info.description:
Physics-based production-network solving, PVT/EOS, flow assurance and transient multiphase flow.

**Units are SI throughout** — pressure MPa, temperature K, rates kSm³/day, lengths m. Permeability in millidarcy is the single exception.

Every operation costs credits, quoted per tool in `x-graphsolve-credits` as `base_credits + ceil(max(0, wall_ms - free_ms) / ms_per_credit)`. Catalogue lookups are free.

network_json.description:
Complete network definition in the model format. Accepts the object
directly, or the same payload as a JSON string.

The elements of a saved model as they are stored: `elements[]` of
`{group, data}` with string ids, `node_type` by name
(`fixed_rate_source`, `fixed_pressure_source`, `pressure_dependent_source`,
`network_node`, `fixed_pressure_sink`, `fixed_rate_sink`), `edge_type` by
name (`no_pressure_loss`, `pipe`, `choke`, `heat_exchanger`, `compressor`,
`pump`, `turbine`, `jt_valve`, `heater_cooler`, `reactor`), edges joined by
`source`/`target`, with the `fluids`, `sources` and `process_equipment`
libraries at the top level and an optional `solve_parameters` block. A
model exported from the app is accepted as it is. The reply carries
`results` on each element.
